summary: Quote mode across a dropped socket: the new socket logs in, authenticates on its first binary frame and registers again; the day OHLC received before the drop stays in the next quote, as on the web.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.
The web keeps last_quotes across a reconnect (on_close clears nothing); so does the desktop's FeedState.

deviations.reason: Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (lead rule 2026-11-09): Motilal's web adapter puts the subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full).

The desktop sends its receipt time as ltt: Motilal's packets carry no trade time either side reads (the packet header's time is undocumented and unused), and the web sends no ltt. A receipt time is not a trade time (lead decision 2026-11-09): mark the last trade time absent.

Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (lead rule 2026-11-09): Motilal's web Quote dict names the last traded quantity ltq only; the desktop sends the canonical last_quantity and ltq beside it with the same value (feed::dialect, WS-05).
Motilal's packets carry no book totals; the desktop sends 0, the web leaves the total out. Mark the totals absent.

Before Motilal's day OHLC packet (G) the desktop sends 0.0 and the web 0 for open, high, low and the previous close: neither was received. The desktop is to leave them out until the G packet; the web's zeros are then a web defect.
